# logfire_channel (Resource)

Manages a Logfire alert channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "logfire_channel" "example" {
  name   = "alerts-webhook"
  active = true

  config {
    type   = "webhook"
    format = "auto"
    url    = "https://example.com/logfire-webhook"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Channel name.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the channel is active.
- `config` (Block, Optional) Required channel configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.

<a id="nestedblock--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `type` (String) Channel type (`webhook` or `opsgenie`).

Optional:

- `auth_key` (String, Sensitive) Opsgenie API key.
- `format` (String) Webhook payload format.
- `url` (String) Webhook URL endpoint.
